about: P2 round 3: the A/A runs Alex asked for on 2026-10-28 (via the coordinator), "Largest, A/A redone" and "More A/A servers", with his answers of 2026-10-29 to this session: "17.8min is still fine" (Windows' A/A run is redone together with its campaign, both after the boot delay) and "Keep every neighbour" (the floor is set against each pair of neighbours in the ranking). Three jobs, drafted in the lab queue's job format for the operator to copy into queues; not a queue itself. Branch round3 of p2-typed-routing/typed-routing (local; bundled from that checkout as before). On Windows, in this order: p2r3-rr-w2, p2r3-rr-w of requests-2026-10-28-rr.json again unchanged at ed3b7e0 (t3/jobs/rr.py, the A/A run t3/plans/rr-aa-W.json then the campaign rr-W.json), then p2r3-aa-w at d063274742fa4fa4cab5491297571d953b3cfa31, the k-server A/A run rr-aak-W.json through t3/jobs/aa.py. On Arch: p2r3-aa-l at d063274742fa4fa4cab5491297571d953b3cfa31, the k-server A/A run rr-aak-L.json. The k-server plans hold v2 seven times in each of the three programs: 21 servers per cell (the Windows campaign's count; Arch's has 22) and 294 windows, with the campaign's cells, rounds and windows (mixed-disjoint, m = 1,000 and 100,000, pair (111, 211), R = 7, 1.5 s windows after p2gen's 0.1 s lead-in, each server started once per size with a 1 s warm-up). Every job times the Release builds of p2r3-bringup-l and p2r3-bringup-w at 3ff814e50, the builds every round-3 record timed: rr.py and aa.py refuse (exit 2) before the first window unless the clone is clean, each binary's sha256 is the bring-up's and no compiled source changed since 3ff814e50 (none did); aa.py also refuses a plan that is not an A/A plan of that build. No build, no download. The plans rr-aa-W.json and rr-W.json are the same at ed3b7e0 and at the A/A commit. The analysis, t3/rr_results.py at the A/A commit, is committed before the runs: the floor (per program and size, the A/A run's largest |d| over the rounds, set against each pair of neighbours in the campaign's ranking; on Windows both from p2r3-rr-w2's record, which replaces p2r3-rr-w's) and the k-server run's statistics (descriptive; they do not enter the floor). The summaries hold verdicts, shares, start-ups, memory and spacing, no rate. Peak resident memory of the 21 v2 servers at m = 100,000, from the A/A records' per-server peaks: about 1.35 GiB on Arch (7 x 44,800, 80,184 and 76,700 KiB) and 1.19 GiB on Windows (7 x 41,456, 68,984 and 68,232 KiB), plus p2gen. Either system may go first.

jobs.note: Start at least 15 minutes after boot and only once the quiet check passes (the coordinator's rule of 2026-10-28; in A15 p2r3-rr-w began 33 s after boot and others above 10% of one CPU came until about 10 min after it; its m = 1,000 cell ran 4.8 to 11.3 min after boot). p2r3-rr-w again, unchanged but for the id and this note: the same commit, command, plans, outputs and limits, so its A/A run gives Windows' floor and its campaign the leads the floor is set against, both after the boot delay. A15 took 17.8 min, 4.3 min of it reruns of host-spoiled rounds. p2r3-rr-w's note follows. The A/A run (84 windows) then the campaign (294 windows, 21 servers per size), as p2r3-rr-l; reads C:\Users\alext\lab\p2r3\build-3ff814e50, progs-3ff814e50 (p2v2.dll beside mserver-go.exe) and sets, writes only in LAB_OUT. expected_s from p2r3-pilot-w's and p2r3-probe-w-2's measured spacing (6.29 s, so 0.29 s more per window): a window costs 1.89 s; campaign 294 x 1.89 = 556 s, 42 warm-ups x 1.39 = 58 s, starts at most 2 x 18.8 s, preflight about 6 s and the 10 s session clock: about 668 s; A/A 84 x 1.89 = 159 s, 12 warm-ups 17 s, starts, preflight and the session clock about 14 s: about 190 s; together about 860 s, rounded up to 1,000. timeout_s three times that. W quiet hours: the whole job, about a quarter of an hour. Boost off, the lab's default.
